detailZh: 意大利大奖赛前，哈斯F1车队领队小松礼雄亲自驾驶一辆历史悠久的F1赛车
哈斯车队领队小松礼雄在意大利大奖赛前驾驶了一辆1990年的Footwork Arrows A11B赛车
哈斯F1车队领队小松礼雄完成了一次赛道体验，在意大利大奖赛前驾驶了一辆1990年的Footwork Arrows A11B赛车。
这位日本籍车队负责人于本周早些时候驾驶了这款搭载Cosworth发动机的赛车。A11B是Ross Brawn设计的A11的改进版，在1990年的F1赛季中曾由Michele Alboreto、Alex Caffi和Bernd Schneider驾驶。
A11B搭载一台3.5升自然吸气的福特考斯沃斯（Ford Cosworth）DFR V8发动机，它只获得过一次积分，即Caffi在1990年摩纳哥大奖赛上取得第五名。
小松的到访是在2026赛季第13轮比赛之前。哈斯车队开局不错，在赛季前六轮中有五轮拿到积分，但此后一直未能得分。这支美国车队目前以21分位居车队积分榜第七位。
车手奥利·贝尔曼（Ollie Bearman）和埃斯特班·奥孔（奥康）在蒙扎的第一次练习赛中分别排在第14和第18快，第二次练习赛中分别排在第8和第18快，第三次练习赛中分别排在第14和第17快。
“意大利大奖赛对我们来说一直是一场特别的比赛，因为我们的设计办公室位于意大利马拉内罗，”小松在比赛周末前的车队前瞻中解释道。“我们借此机会欢迎许多车队同事来到蒙扎，让他们亲身体验自己每天努力工作的意义，并享受这种真正特别的氛围。”
“我们将抵达意大利，决心把赞德沃特那个令人沮丧的周末彻底抛在身后。在运作层面当然有一些积极因素，但归根结底，我们仍然希望能从VF-26赛车上挖掘出更多性能。
“本周末，我们将为赛车带来另一套升级包，所以同样地，关键是我们要最大限度地利用练习时间，全面评估数据，并努力在中游集团中继续保持推进。”
“下半赛季的比赛一场接一场，非常密集——这很棒，但确实是个挑战。去年我们已经证明，即使到了赛季深处，我们依然能够持续找到性能，这也是我们继续关注的重点。”

detailEn: Haas F1 boss Ayao Komatsu gets behind wheel of historic F1 car ahead of Italian GP
Haas team principal Ayao Komatsu drove a 1990 Footwork Arrows A11B ahead of the Italian Grand Prix
Haas Formula 1 team principal Ayao Komatsu has completed a track outing, driving a 1990 Footwork Arrows A11B ahead of the Italian Grand Prix.

The Japanese team chief took the wheel of the Cosworth-powered chassis earlier this week. The A11B, an evolution of the Ross Brawn-designed A11, was driven during the 1990 F1 season by Michele Alboreto, Alex Caffi and Bernd Schneider.
Powered by a 3.5-litre naturally aspirated Ford Cosworth DFR V8, the A11B scored points only once, with Caffi's fifth place at the 1990 Monaco Grand Prix.

Komatsu's outing came ahead of the 13th round of the 2026 season. While Haas got off to a decent start, picking up points in five of the six opening rounds, it has since failed to score. The American outfit currently sits seventh in the constructors' standings with 21 points.

Drivers Ollie Bearman and Esteban Ocon went 14th and 18th fastest in the first practice session at Monza, eighth and 18th fastest in second practice and 14th and 17th fastest in the third practice session, respectively.

"The Italian Grand Prix is always a special one for us with our design office located in Maranello, Italy," Komatsu explained in the team's preview ahead of the race weekend. "We take the opportunity to welcome many of our team-mates to Monza and have them experience what they are working for every day, and enjoy the atmosphere, which is truly special.

"We’ll be arriving in Italy keen to put a frustrating weekend in Zandvoort firmly behind us. There were positives for sure operationally, but ultimately, we were still looking to find more performance from the VF-26.
"This weekend, we’re bringing another upgrade package to the car, so again, it’s critical we maximise our practice time, evaluate our data comprehensively, and strive to keep pushing in the midfield.

"The races in the second half of the season come thick and fast – which is great – but it’s a challenge for sure. We showed last year that we can continue to find performance deep into the season, and that’s our continued focus."

George Russell tops Lewis Hamilton in final practice at Monza; Mercedes appear to have edge over Ferrari going into qualifying; watch Italian Grand Prix Qualifying later on Saturday at 3pm, with build-up from 2.15pm, live on Sky Sports F1 and Main Event
Lewis Hamilton and Max Verstappen fought a wheel-to-wheel battle for during P3 of the Italian Grand Prix at Monza
George Russell established himself as pole position favourite ahead of Italian Grand Prix qualifying as the Mercedes driver topped Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton in final practice.

Mercedes and Ferrari had appeared closely matched in Friday's two practice sessions, and once more led the way on Saturday as Russell's time of 1:22.219s put him just over two tenths of a second clear of Hamilton at Monza.

Russell is shouldering Mercedes' hopes of claiming pole, with his team-mate Kimi Antonelli, the championship leader, serving penalties for taking new engine parts that will leave him starting from the back of the grid regardless of where he qualifies.

Despite being more focused on his long-run setup for Sunday's race, Antonelli, who leads both Russell and Hamilton by 59 points at the top of the standings, was fourth behind Red Bull's Max Verstappen.
McLaren's Lando Norris, who has closed to within 83 points of Antonelli by winning the last two races, was fifth ahead of Ferrari's Charles Leclerc.
Mercedes tried out using Antonelli to give Russell a highly-beneficial tow around the high-speed circuit, but the Brit's fastest laps came without the help of his team-mate.
Ferrari driver Lewis Hamilton braces for a tight Italian GP qualifying as Mercedes continue to find more pace

Ferrari appear to have reduced their straight-line speed deficit to Mercedes after bringing to Monza their second engine upgrade of the season, but it appears the Italian squad will need to find something extra to claim what would be an extremely popular pole at their home race.

There was drama in the closing moments of the session as Hamilton and Verstappen almost collided at the first corner after a squabble for track position ahead of what should have been their final attempts at flying laps.

Hamilton snuck ahead of Verstappen as they approached the final corner, which angered the Dutchman, prompting him to attempt to race the Ferrari over the start-finish line and then dive up the inside into the first corner.

Hamilton bailed out to prevent contact, avoiding a repeat of the pair's famous collision at the 2021 Italian Grand Prix when they were battling for the drivers' title. The stewards noted the incident but decided an investigation wasn't necessary.
Russell has endured a difficult season having started the year of favourite before being outperformed by his far less experience team-mate.
However, the 28-year-old appears to have found a groove at Monza, with pole position having the potential to reignite his championship challenge.
Sky Sports F1's Naomi Schiff said: "George will be very pleased with himself. This is such a psychological sport and with a team-mate leading the championship he does need to switch that momentum.
"This session has been the most positive for Mercedes. They aren't losing much anywhere on deployment through the lap."

detailZh: 国际汽联上诉法院回应弗拉维奥·布里亚托利的偏袒指控
国际汽联国际上诉法院发表声明，回应阿尔派高管布里亚托利关于摩纳哥大奖赛案中一名法官与迈凯伦有联系的指控。

Gasly是在摩纳哥因维修区超速而被错误处罚的几名车手之一，他一度失去了领奖台位置，随后阿尔派发起了复审程序并获得成功。但由于其他车手已经服完处罚，与Gasly不同，他们无法撤销处罚，于是迈凯伦和红牛提起了上诉。
国际上诉法庭（ICA）支持了上诉方，恢复了Gasly的处罚，这让这位法国车手和他的阿尔派车队感到沮丧。但车队的高层老板Briatore在意大利大奖赛新闻发布会上发表了一番激烈的言论，把事情进一步升级，质疑评审小组的公正性，因为据称其中一名法官与迈凯伦有牵连。

涉事法官Filippo Marchino曾担任One Drop基金会的首席执行官，该基金会是由太阳马戏团创始人Guy Laliberte创办的慈善机构。在此职位期间，已故迈凯伦股东Mansour Ojjeh曾向该慈善机构赠送了几辆迈凯伦公路跑车，用于通过拍卖为慈善机构筹款。Briatore还提到了2018年迈凯伦 Special Operations在比佛利山庄举办的一场活动，Marchino曾作为演讲者出席，该活动与F1车队无关。
FIA国际上诉法庭发表声明回应Briatore的爆炸性指控，解释称评审法官小组是依照其司法程序组建的。
国际上诉法院（ICA）在评论中写道，针对迈凯伦与红牛上诉案：“FIA法庭已注意到有公开言论质疑审理ICA-2026-06-07-08-09号案件的合议庭法官的独立性和公正性。”
"FIA法庭希望明确表示，与其他任何案件一样，该案法官的任命和参与均是依照适用的FIA司法程序和惯例进行的，这些程序和惯例以最高标准为蓝本，例如《国际律师协会国际仲裁利益冲突指引》。"
"所有法官均由FIA大会选举产生，其中一些人是根据FIA章程由至少五支F1车队组成的小组提议而任命的。他们都须遵守FIA司法与纪律规则中规定的独立性和保密性要求，每年向FIA合规官披露利益情况，并针对每个具体案件，结合所涉问题和相关各方签署一份专门的独立性声明，该声明会送达各方当事人。"
ICA表示，在上诉听证会开始之前，没有任何人对合议庭的组成提出异议，并解释了为何其热衷于任命具有不同背景的法官。
声明继续说：“在听证会开始和结束时，双方均被邀请就诉讼程序或法庭组成提出任何问题。没有人这样做。”“听证会期间，没有任何人对法庭质询证人或进行诉讼的方式提出异议。
国际上诉法院（ICA）强调，组建由来自不同文化和地域背景的法官组成合议庭非常重要。这有助于确保评议和讨论反映多元的法律传统、观点和方法，进一步加强程序的公正性、独立性和可信度，以及获得公平审判的机会。
国际上诉法院补充说：“法院的裁决在其法律依据方面可能存在各种不同的解读和评论空间；这是公平的，也是所有法官都能接受的。法院对诉讼程序的稳妥性和法官的公正性充满信心。国际汽联（FIA）的法院始终致力于维护法官的独立性和公正性，以及司法程序的公正性。

detailEn: FIA's Court of Appeal responds to Flavio Briatore bias allegations
The FIA's International Court of Appeal issued a statement in response to Alpine executive Briatore's claims one of its judges in the Monaco GP case had McLaren links

The International Court of Appeal defended and clarified the appointment of its judges in the Monaco Grand Prix appeal amid allegations by Alpine boss Flavio Briatore that one of the judges had ties to McLaren.

The International Court of Appeal, which runs independently of the FIA, is the highest court judging over motorsport related matters and was called into action when McLaren and Red Bull appealed against the stewards' decision to rescind Alpine driver Pierre Gasly's Monaco Grand Prix penalties.

Gasly was one of several drivers incorrectly penalised in Monaco for pitlane speeding, initially losing his podium before Alpine launched a successful right of review procedure. But as other drivers had already served their penalties, unlike Gasly, they could not get their penalties rescinded, with McLaren and Red Bull launching an appeal.

The ICA agreed with the appellants and reinstated Gasly's penalties, frustrating the Frenchman and his Alpine squad. But the team's top boss Briatore took matters further when he launched an explosive rant during the Italian Grand Prix press conference, questioning the integrity of the panel because one judge was purported to have links with McLaren.

The judge in question, Filippo Marchino, served as CEO of the One Drop Foundation, a charity founded by Cirque du Soleil impresario Guy Laliberte. In that capacity, the charity was once gifted several McLaren road cars by late McLaren shareholder Mansour Ojjeh, for the purpose of raising money for the charity via auction. Briatore also referenced an event by McLaren Special Operations in Beverley Hills in 2018, where Marchino appeared as a speaker, an event unrelated to the F1 team.

The FIA's International Court of Appeal has issued a statement in response to Briatore's explosive allegations, explaining the panel of judges was put together in accordance with its judicial procedures.

"The FIA Courts are aware of public comments questioning the independence and impartiality of the judges of the panel that decided Case ICA-2026-06-07-08-09," the ICA commented, referring to the McLaren and Red Bull appeal.

"The FIA Courts wish to make clear that the appointment and participation of the judges in that case, like for any other case, were conducted in accordance with the applicable FIA judicial procedures and usual practice, which are inspired by the highest standards like the IBA Guidelines on Conflicts of Interest in International Arbitration.

"All judges are elected by the FIA General Assemblies, some of them upon proposition of a group of at least five F1 teams in accordance with the FIA statutes. They are all subject to the independence and confidentiality requirements contained in the FIA Judicial and Disciplinary Rules, make annual disclosures of interests to the FIA compliance officer, and sign a specific declaration of independence for each particular case in consideration of the issue at stake and the parties involved, which is served to the parties."
The ICA said there were no objections to the composition of the panel before the appeal hearing started, and explained why it is keen to appoint judges with different backgrounds.

"At both the beginning and conclusion of the hearing, the parties were invited to raise any issue concerning the proceedings or the composition of the court. None did so," the statement continued. "No objection was raised during the hearing concerning the manner in which the court questioned the witness or conducted the proceedings.

"The ICA emphasises the importance of constituting panels with judges from different cultural and geographical backgrounds. This helps ensure that the deliberations and discussions reflect a diversity of legal traditions, perspectives and approaches, further strengthening the fairness, independence, credibility of the process and access to a fair trial."

The ICA added: "A court’s decision can leave room for various interpretations and comments as for its legal merits; that is fair and accepted by all the judges. The court is confident in the soundness of the proceedings and the integrity of the judges. The FIA courts remain committed to the independence and impartiality of their judges and to the integrity of the judicial process."

items.originalTitle: F2发布改进版赛车，向F1 2026新规靠拢
items.summaryEn: Formula 2 has revealed a heavily modified car at the Italian Grand Prix that looks closer to F1's current machines and aligns with F1's 2026 rules era.
detailZh: Formula 2 在意大利大奖赛上展示了为接下来几个赛季大幅修改的赛车，使其外观更接近 Formula 1 目前的赛车。
这款经修改的赛车将保留现有底盘，周六在蒙扎的 F1 维修区亮相，将从 2027 年到 2029 年用于 F1 的主要预备系列赛。
F2 上一次推出新赛车是在 2024 年，目的是更贴近 F1 在 2022 至 2025 年使用的地面效应时代赛车的外观。
这款新的 2027 年赛车更好地反映了 F1 全新 2026 年赛车的视觉方向，但并未进行彻底翻新，从而将成本控制在较低水平。
它的空气动力学套件同样旨在让赛车能够更贴近地跟随前车行驶。
新车将搭载与2024-26世代相同的3.4升涡轮增压V6 Mecachrome发动机。
它将再次使用18英寸轮毂，早在2020年的赛车上就率先采用了这一规格，比F1采纳18英寸轮毂早了两年。
这款车将使用由阿斯顿·马丁F1车队合作伙伴沙特阿美提供的可持续燃料。
这辆赛车将首次配备车载启动器，这意味着熄火的赛车不太可能被困在赛道上。
F2表示，这是通过与供应商Hewland合作开发“现有变速箱的进化版”实现的。
它应该就是兰多·诺里斯（诺里斯）全新LN4 Fusion车队明年将使用的赛车，该车队由前Prema领队雷内·罗辛（Rene Rosin）领导。
该车队的参赛资格尚未正式获批，但这被认为只是走个形式。
detailEn: Formula 2 has revealed a heavily modified car for the coming seasons at the Italian Grand Prix, bringing it closer to the look of Formula 1's current machine.
The revised car, which will retain the existing chassis, was revealed in the F1 paddock at Monza on Saturday and will be used in F1's primary feeder series from 2027 to 2029.
F2 last introduced a new car in 2024 to more closely mirror the look of F1's ground-effect-era cars used from 2022-25.
This new 2027 car better reflects the visual direction of F1's new 2026 cars but without being a complete overhaul, keeping costs lower.
Its aero package is also designed to allow cars to follow each other more closely.
The new car will be powered by the same 3.4-litre turbocharged V6 Mecachrome engine used in the 2024-26 generation.
And it will run on 18-inch wheelrims once more, having pioneered them on its 2020 car, two years before F1 adopted them.
The car will run on sustainable fuel, supplied by Aramco, partner of Aston Martin's F1 team.
For the first time, the car will feature an on-board starter, meaning stalled cars are less likely to be stranded.
F2 said this had been accomplished through the development of "an evolution of the current gearbox" from supplier Hewland.
It should be the car used by Lando Norris's brand-new LN4 Fusion team next year, led by former Prema leader Rene Rosin.
The team is yet to be officially granted an entry, but this is believed to be a formality.

items.originalTitle: 布里亚托雷与FIA争端持续，上诉法院回应
items.summaryEn: The FIA International Court of Appeal has issued a statement defending its processes after Alpine executive advisor Flavio Briatore made comments that appeared to question the independence of one of its judges.
detailZh: 国际汽联国际上诉法院发布了一份声明，为其自身的程序进行辩护。此前，阿尔派车队F1执行顾问弗拉维奥·布里亚托利的言论似乎质疑了该法院陪审团中一名法官的独立性。
布里亚托利在周五意大利大奖赛的一场新闻发布会上公开向迈凯伦发难。此举发生在国际汽联通报其国际上诉法院裁定恢复皮埃尔·加斯利在6月摩纳哥大奖赛所受的两项五秒处罚之后——阿尔派此前曾成功将这些处罚撤销。
这意味着加斯利第二次失去了领奖台，尽管他此前以第三名的成绩冲线。
虽然布里亚托利表示他接受这一决定，但他也似乎质疑了在8月听证会上陪审团四名法官之一菲利波·马尔基诺的公正性。
布里亚托利一边不断参照一张纸上的内容，一边声称马尔基诺在听证会上表现得"非常恶劣"，并且"扮演着检察官的角色"。
"然后，我们发现了这家伙为什么这么恶劣的原因。他和迈凯伦关系非常密切。我很惊讶这个人和迈凯伦有联系，"布里亚托利说。
提到迈凯伦是切中要害的，因为它是与红牛一起对恢复加斯利第三名成绩的决定提出上诉的两支车队之一。
在国际汽联上诉法院周六上午发布的一份声明中，该法院否定了关于其法官遴选程序不公正的任何说法。
声明没有直接点名Briatore，但表示这些评论涉及案件ICA-2026-06-07-08-09——即由迈凯伦和红牛提起的诉讼案件的听证会。
FIA声明写道：“FIA法院希望明确，该案中法官的任命和参与，与任何其他案件一样，都是按照适用的FIA司法程序和惯例进行的，这些程序和惯例遵循最高标准，例如IBA关于国际仲裁中利益冲突的准则。”
“所有法官均由FIA代表大会选举产生，其中部分法官是根据至少五支F1车队组成的团体的提名、依照FIA章程选举产生的。”
“他们都受FIA司法和纪律规则中规定的独立性和保密性要求约束，每年向FIA合规官披露利益情况，并针对每个具体案件，结合所涉问题和有关各方签署一份特定的独立性声明，该声明会送达各方。”
国际上诉法院拥有一份由36位顶尖法律专家组成的名单，其中至少有八人会被选入一个候选池，每个案件均可从中挑选人选。
该候选池会提前告知相关各方，以评估是否存在"严重且客观的理由认为任何或全部入围法官因存在利益冲突或其他正当理由而应当回避"。
声明称这一程序已经进行，相关各方"被邀请就诉讼程序或法庭组成提出任何问题"。
"没有人这样做，"声明补充道，"在庭审过程中，没有人就法庭询问证人或进行诉讼程序的方式提出任何异议。"
“国际上诉法院强调，组建由来自不同文化和地域背景的法官组成的合议庭非常重要。这有助于确保审议和讨论反映多元的法律传统、观点和方法，进一步强化程序的公正性、独立性、可信度以及获得公平审判的机会。
“一项判决在其法律依据方面可能存在多种解释和评论的空间；这是公平的，并且为所有法官所接受。法院对程序的严谨性和法官的正直性充满信心。FIA法院仍然致力于维护法官的独立性与公正性，以及司法程序的完整性。”
detailEn: The FIA International Court of Appeal has issued a statement defending its processes in the wake of Alpine Formula 1 executive advisor Flavio Briatore's comments that appeared to question the independence of one judge on its panel.

Briatore started a public row against McLaren during a press conference appearance at the Italian Grand Prix on Friday. That came after the FIA communicated that its International Court of Appeal had ruled to reinstate the two five-second penalties that Pierre Gasly incurred at the Monaco GP in June, which Alpine had previously successfully had quashed.
This meant Gasly lost his podium for a second time, having crossed the line in third.
While Briatore said he accepted the decision, he also appeared to question the impartiality of one of the four ICA judges - Filippo Marchino - on the panel during the August hearing.
Reading from a piece of paper that he continued to refer to, Briatore claimed Marchino had been "very nasty during the hearing" and was "acting as a prosecutor".
"And after, we found out what is the reason why he's so nasty, this guy? He's very linked with McLaren. I'm very surprised this guy has the link with McLaren," Briatore said.
That McLaren mention is pertinent because it was one of two teams, alongside Red Bull, that had appealed the decision to reinstate Gasly to third place.
In a statement released on Saturday morning, the FIA Court of Appeal rejected any suggestion that the process of its selection of judges had not been impartial.
It did not name Briatore directly but said the comments related to case ICA-2026-06-07-08-09 - the hearing for the case brought by McLaren and Red Bull.

"The FIA courts wish to make clear that the appointment and participation of the judges in that case, like for any other case, were conducted in accordance with the applicable FIA judicial procedures and usual practice, which are inspired by the highest standards like the IBA guidelines on conflicts of interest in international arbitration," the FIA statement read.
"All judges are elected by the FIA general assemblies, some of them upon proposition of a group of at least five F1 teams in accordance with the FIA statutes.

"They are all subject to the independence and confidentiality requirements contained in the FIA judicial and disciplinary rules, make annual disclosures of interests to the FIA compliance officer, and sign a specific declaration of independence for each particular case in consideration of the issue at stake and the parties involved, which is served to the parties."
The International Court of Appeal has a roster of 36 leading legal experts, at least eight of whom are selected to be part of a pool that can be picked for each case.

This pool is communicated to relevant parties ahead of time to assess whether there are any "serious and objective reasons to consider that any or all of the shortlisted judges should be recused due to the existence of a conflict of interest or other legitimate grounds".
The statement said this had happened, with the relevant parties "invited to raise any issue concerning the proceedings or the composition of the court".
"None did so," the statement added. "No objection was raised during the hearing concerning the manner in which the court questioned the witness or conducted the proceedings.

"The ICA emphasises the importance of constituting panels with judges from different cultural and geographical backgrounds. This helps ensure that the deliberations and discussions reflect a diversity of legal traditions, perspectives and approaches, further strengthening the fairness, independence, credibility of the process and access to a fair trial.

The FIA courts remain committed to the independence and impartiality of their judges and to the integrity of the judicial process."

items.titleZh: F1车队在蒙扎的能量部署模式揭示了什么
items.summaryZh: 2026年F1赛车在蒙扎这条能量最匮乏的赛道上呈现出明显的能量部署差异，这些差异反映了各车队动力单元管理策略的不同。
items.originalTitle: F1车队在蒙扎的能量部署模式揭示了什么
items.summaryEn: The 2026 Formula 1 cars show clear differences in energy deployment at Monza, the most energy-starved track since the in-season rule changes were agreed in April, revealing differences in how teams manage their power units.
detailZh: 自今年四月赛季内规则修改达成一致以来，2026年一级方程式赛车在蒙扎正处于能量最匮乏的状态，目前各赛车在能量部署方面存在许多值得关注的差异。
各车队——尤其是厂商车队及其客户车队——到了排位赛时往往会在能量部署上趋于接近，而周五的差别则更大。
但通过分析数据、长距离测试里程以及车队和车手在意大利大奖赛上到目前为止的表态，我们仍能看到一些有趣的规律。
法拉利本周末受益于升级后的'ADUO 2'动力单元，但鉴于车队淡化了这个升级幅度有多大，没有理由认为梅赛德斯不再是2026年动力单元的标杆。
从节奏对比数据来看，乔治·拉塞尔在二练做出的全场最快圈速（绿色）与夏尔·勒克莱尔的最佳成绩（红色；慢0.120秒）相比，可以看出法拉利在前三条直道上都输给了梅赛德斯，以至于进入阿斯卡里弯时勒克莱尔已经落后了0.466秒。
从阿斯卡里弯出来驶向帕拉波利卡弯（阿尔博雷托弯）时，法拉利追回了大部分损失的时间——这是一个有趣的动力输出分配差异，如果周末保持这一状态，周日的第一圈肯定会非常精彩。而且正如亚历克斯·阿尔本在周四指出的那样，还要加上一点：“法拉利在（开局阶段）往往很善于抓机会；他们会使用不同的模式，能让其他赛车措手不及”。
如果想更深入了解法拉利在意大利大奖赛开局的表现，请查看埃德·斯特罗的分析。
升级后的法拉利引擎到底有多强？
对比哈斯车队的两名车手确实给你提供了一个不同寻常的机会，可以评估升级后的法拉利动力单元，因为奥利·贝尔曼已经用上了，而队友埃斯特班·奥康还没有。
不过这也有一个前提，那就是奥康一直受到部件一致性问题的影响，这个问题困扰了哈斯整个赛季。
这些不一致往往会导致下压力损失或某种异常的驾驶感受，这肯定能在很大程度上解释奥康比贝尔曼慢一秒的原因——贝尔曼在第二次自由练习中排名第八。
但是贝尔曼（紫色线）和奥康（白色线）在直道上的速度差异非常明显，无论是开往阿斯卡里弯还是进入帕拉波利卡弯的路段都能看出来。
说实在的，我们只有先解决那些部件规格不一致的问题，才能真正知道各款动力单元之间的差距。
毫无疑问，哈斯车队（两辆赛车都装上了）的空气动力学升级套件表现相当出色，博尔曼称之为自三月份以来“最好的周五”。
这正是哈斯急需的，因为该车队长久以来一直游离在积分区之外，自六月份摩纳哥大奖赛之后的六轮比赛都未能得分。
从周五的表现来看，迈凯伦对蒙扎赛道会很难打的预期看起来是正确的——兰多·诺里斯在单圈速度上比拉塞尔慢了近十分之四秒，而在长距离节奏上差距还要更大一些。
迈凯伦负责工程的技术总监尼尔·霍尔迪说：“从能量角度来看，我们还有一些工作要做。”
“确实有圈速可以争取，一部分在充电（管理）上，一部分在能量部署（deployment）上。”
GP Tempo 的数据确实支持了这一点，如果你对比拉塞尔（绿色曲线）和诺里斯（木瓜色曲线）。
即使使用相同的动力单元，迈凯伦在一号弯之后的三条长直道上都在损失时间——尤其是驶向帕拉波利卡弯的那一段格外痛苦。
我们今年已经多次看到，梅赛德斯和客户车队迈凯伦在周五采用截然不同的能量释放策略，而迈凯伦会在学习之后从排位赛开始逐渐趋同。
迈凯伦成功运行了它所称的“H翼”（H-wing）的修改版本，除非车队在数据中突然发现什么问题，否则“没有理由把它拆下来”。
诺里斯总结道：“我们会看看今晚能改些什么，但与过去几个周末相比，我们的处境没那么好，所以，是的，很艰难。”
它较短的齿比在这里也帮不上忙。它知道自己今年把齿比调错了，但由于成本原因，它不想动用唯一一次的更改机会（奥迪已经用过），这笔成本本可以用于空气动力学升级。
红牛的情况也差不多，如果它想有机会加入梅赛德斯与法拉利的争夺，就需要一个富有成效的隔夜调整期。对车队来说唯一的安慰是维斯塔潘的长距离跑很扎实，只比梅赛德斯慢了零点三秒，这可能支撑了技术总监皮埃尔·瓦克的希望：如果红牛能在一夜之间取得进步，登上领奖台仍然是有可能的。
对于阿斯顿·马丁-本田来说，这是最糟糕的情况下的赛道，因为它在动力单元上有相当大的差距——而升级后的“第二规格”引擎并没有解决这个问题。
对比费尔南多·阿隆索在第二次自由练习中的最快单圈与中场领跑者阿尔维德·林德布拉德的最快单圈，可以清楚地看到阿隆索在每一条直道上都有巨大的损失。
仅在驶向一号弯的直道上，阿隆索就损失了零点四秒，而从阿斯卡里弯出口到帕拉博利卡弯更是损失了整整半秒。
本田的首席工程师折原慎太郎表示：“从成绩可以看出，与竞争对手相比，我们的直道速度还不够。
'这并不意外，我们知道在这条对动力单元性能如此重要的赛道上，这个问题会暴露出来。'
'因此，这条赛道对我们来说是一个挑战。我们会优化设定，尽可能将我们的性能最大化，但对接下来会发生什么，我们应该保持现实的态度。'
接下来他们很可能要与凯迪拉克以及潜在的威廉姆斯展开争夺，力争在本周末避免在赞德沃特第九名的水准之后重新跌回发车区末尾。
不出所料，围绕蒙扎跑一圈的单圈GPS数据与一年前相比看起来截然不同。
对比诺里斯在2025年二练做出的最快时间（橙色）与拉塞尔在2026年二练创造的标杆时间（绿色），可以说有天壤之别——两者相差2.681秒。
在两个莱斯莫弯之间、以及驶向阿斯卡里弯、帕拉波利卡弯和冲线的一段直道上，差异相当明显。
与赛季中规则修改之前我们在直道末端看到的那种戏剧性的速度骤降不同，现在的表现更像是速度趋于平缓，但正是在这些地方，他们比一年前损失了大量时间。
周四，奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里表示，在周末前的模拟中，蒙扎赛道直道末段的速度比匈牙利站要慢——周五的情况证实了这一点，拉塞尔在匈牙利站一号弯结束时比蒙扎任何一条直道末段都要快6公里/小时。
考虑到倍耐力预计周日的比赛将是一次轻松的一停策略，而且周五轮胎的衰退程度很小，不同的能量释放与回收策略将再次成为关键因素。
detailEn: The 2026 Formula 1 cars are at their most energy-starved at Monza since the in-season rule changes were agreed in April, and there are currently plenty of telling differences in energy deployment between the cars.
Teams - particularly manufacturers and their customers - often converge closer on energy deployment come qualifying, with more variance on Friday.
But there's still some interesting patterns we can see from analysing the data, the long run times and what the teams and drivers have said so far at the Italian Grand Prix.

Ferrari has the benefit of its upgraded 'ADUO 2' power unit this weekend but, given the team's played down how big a step it is, there's no reason to believe Mercedes still doesn't have the benchmark 2026 power unit.

Looking at the GP Tempo data of George Russell's FP2-topping time (green) and Charles Leclerc's best (red; 0.120 seconds slower), you can see the Ferrari loses time to the Mercedes on the first three straights, to the point where Leclerc is 0.466s adrift on the entry to Ascari.

It's out of Ascari and towards the Parabolica (Alboreto corner) where Ferrari claws back most of that time - an interesting deployment split that, if maintained, would certainly make lap one on Sunday exciting. And you can add to that, as Alex Albon pointed out on Thursday, that "the Ferraris tend to be quite opportunistic in [the opening laps]; they run different modes, and they can catch other cars out".
Check out Edd Straw's analysis for a more in-depth look at Ferrari's start to the Italian GP.
How strong is the upgraded Ferrari engine?
Comparing the Haas drivers does give you an unusual opportunity to assess the upgraded Ferrari power unit as Ollie Bearman has it and team-mate Esteban Ocon doesn't.
Though that does come with the caveat that Ocon was suffering from the parts inconsistency issues that have hurt Haas all season.
Those inconsistencies often result in a loss of downforce or feeling that will certainly explain a lot of Ocon's one-second deficit to Bearman - who was eighth fastest in FP2.
But the straightline speed difference between Bearman (purple) and Ocon (white) is noticeable on the run to both Ascari and into the Parabolica.
Really, we'd need those parts inconsistencies to be solved to know the true difference in power units.
Certainly Haas's aero upgrade (which is on both cars) is performing well with what Bearman described as "the best Friday" since March.
That's sorely needed as Haas has long drifted outside of points-scoring contention, having not scored at the six rounds since Monaco in June.

McLaren's expectations of a tough Monza look correct based on its Friday performance, where Lando Norris was almost four tenths off Russell on single lap pace, and slightly further away on long-run pace.
McLaren’s technical director for engineering Neil Houldey said: "From an energy perspective, we've still got a bit of work to do.
"There's certainly laptime there available to us, a little bit moving around recharge, moving around deployment."
The GP Tempo data certainly supports that when you compare Russell (green) and Norris (papaya).
Even with the same power unit, McLaren is losing out on the three long straights after Turn 1 - with the run to Parabolica particularly painful.
We have seen plenty of times this year quite different energy deployment strategies between Mercedes and customer McLaren on Friday, before McLaren learns and starts to converge by qualifying.
McLaren did successfully run the modified version of what it's dubbing its "H-wing", with "no reason to take it off" unless the team has suddenly found something wrong in the data overnight.
Norris summarised: "We'll see what we can change overnight, but we're not in as good a position compared to the last few weekends, so, yeah, tough."

Its shorter gear ratios won't be helping it here either. It knows it pitched them wrong this year, but it doesn't want to use its one joker to change them (as Audi has) because of the cost, which could instead go to aerodynamic upgrades.

Red Bull is in a similar position and will have needed a fruitful overnight period if it's to have any chance of joining the Mercedes/Ferrari fight. The only silver lining for the team was Verstappen's solid long run where he was only three tenths off the Mercedes, which probably underpins technical director Pierre Wache's hope that a podium is still possible if Red Bull takes a step forward overnight.
This is the worst-case scenario circuit for Aston Martin-Honda, given its sizeable power unit deficit - one that its upgraded 'Spec 2' engine hasn't solved.
Looking at Fernando Alonso's best FP2 lap versus midfield leader Arvid Lindblad's, there are clear major losses on every straight.
Alonso loses four tenths on the run to Turn 1 alone and a whopping half a second from exiting Ascari to Parabolica.
Honda's chief engineer Shintaro Orihara said: "As we can see from the results, our straightline speed isn't enough compared to our competitors.
"This isn't a surprise, and we knew this was coming at a circuit where the power unit performance is so important.
"Therefore, this track presents a challenge for us. We will optimise our settings to maximise our performance as much as possible, but we should remain realistic for what’s to come."
What's to come is likely a fight with Cadillac and potentially Williams to avoid returning to the back of the grid this weekend after the Zandvoort ninth-place watermark.
As expected, the GPS data of a single lap around Monza looks very different to one year ago.
There's a night-and-day difference when you look at Norris's FP2-topping time from 2025 (orange) versus Russell's 2026 FP2 benchmark (green) - with 2.681s between them.
There's a sizeable difference in-between the Lesmos and on the run to Ascari, Parabolica, and the finish line.
There isn't the dramatic tail-off in speed that we saw prior to the in-season rule changes at the end of the straights, but rather a levelling off where they lose a lot of time versus one year ago.

On Thursday, Oscar Piastri said the speeds at the end of the straights in Monza in the pre-weekend simulations were slower than they were in Hungary - and that's proved to be the case on Friday, with Russell 6km/h quicker by the end of Turn 1 in Hungary than at the end of any of the Monza straights.
Given Pirelli is expecting Sunday's race to be an easy one-stop with tyre degradation minimal on Friday, differing energy deployment/harvesting strategies will once again be a critical factor.

胡安·帕布洛·蒙托亚认为红牛应该让利亚姆·劳森继续留在赛车上参加西班牙大奖赛
前一级方程式车手胡安·帕布洛·蒙托亚认为，红牛应该让利亚姆·劳森继续留在赛车上，参加下周在马德里举行的首届西班牙大奖赛，并警告车队不要过早地让伊萨克·哈贾尔匆忙回到驾驶舱。
劳森在最后时刻被征召参加荷兰大奖赛，以顶替哈贾尔，后者在夏休期期间手腕受伤。因此，替补车手角田裕毅进入了劳森在小红牛（小红牛）车队的席位，与阿维德·林德布拉德搭档。
由于几乎没有准备且只有一节练习赛，这位新西兰车手在排位赛中与红牛队友马克斯·维斯塔潘成绩非常接近，令人印象深刻。随后他以第七名完赛，拿下六个积分。
随着劳森继续在本周末于蒙扎举行的意大利大奖赛上代打，蒙托亚在F1电视的《周末热身》节目中表示，红牛明智的做法是让他在即将到来的西班牙大奖赛上继续代打。
“角田在正赛中展现了自己的速度，不断超越对手，充满攻击性。我认为这就是你想从一位车手身上看到的一切。如果你在寻找F1车手，他交出了答卷。他完成了任务。他没有犯错，没有出任何差错，看到这样的表现真的很棒，”这位前车手解释道。
“至于利亚姆，如果我是红牛，尤其是下周即将前往马德里，我会说：‘嘿，让我们聪明一点。我们再给他几周的恢复时间，让利亚姆好好备战马德里，因为对所有人来说那都是一条全新的赛道。’”
劳森目前在车手积分榜上以49分排名第九。哈贾尔以68分排名第八，维斯塔潘以112分排名第六。相比之下，梅赛德斯车队的安东内利以242分领跑积分榜。
西班牙大奖赛将于9月11日至13日在马德里举行，这将是这项运动的车阵（发车区）首次抵达全新的马德林赛道。

detailEn: Red Bull urged to keep Liam Lawson for Spanish GP as Isack Hadjar recovers from injury
Juan Pablo Montoya believes Red Bull should keep Liam Lawson in the car for the Spanish Grand Prix

Former Formula 1 driver Juan Pablo Montoya believes Red Bull should retain Liam Lawson for next week's inaugural Spanish Grand Prix in Madrid, warning the team against prematurely rushing Isack Hadjar back into the cockpit.

Lawson was called up at the last minute for the Dutch Grand Prix to replace Hadjar, who sustained a wrist injury during the summer break. As a result, reserve driver Yuki Tsunoda stepped into Lawson's Racing Bulls seat alongside Arvid Lindblad.

With little preparation and only one practice session, the New Zealander impressed by closely matching Red Bull team-mate Max Verstappen in qualifying. He went on to score six points with a seventh-place finish.

With Lawson continuing to deputise at this weekend's Italian Grand Prix at Monza, Montoya argued on F1 TV's Weekend Warm-Up that Red Bull would be wise to extend his stint for the upcoming Spanish Grand Prix.

"Yuki showed the pace he had in the race, passing people, the aggression. I think everything that you wanted to see out of a driver. If you're looking for drivers in F1, he delivered. He did the job. He didn't make mistakes. He didn't put a wheel wrong, and it was really good to see," the former driver explained.

"With Liam, if I were Red Bull, especially going into Madrid next week, I would go, 'Hey, let's be smart. We're going to get a couple more weeks of recovery, and we'll prepare Liam properly for Madrid because it's a new track for everybody.'"

Lawson currently sits ninth in the drivers' standings with 49 points. Hadjar is eighth with 68 points and Verstappen sits sixth with 112 points. By comparison, Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli leads the championship with 242 points.
The Spanish Grand Prix in Madrid will take place from 11-13 September and will be the first time the grid arrives at the new Madring circuit.

detailZh: 为什么基米·安东内利在意大利大奖赛的复苏可能比预期更艰难
费尔南多·阿隆索曾预测安东内利能在蒙扎从最后一位升至第三，但法拉利引擎性能的提升让这位梅赛德斯车手信心有所减弱
当梅赛德斯把感情因素放在一边，理性地决定让基米·安东内利在主场大奖赛使用第五套F1动力单元时，因为超出年度配额他将从发车区末位起步，车队这样做是有充分理由的。
凭借梅赛德斯2026年动力单元的实力，更何况还是一台全新制造的动力单元，梅赛德斯期待这位年轻挑战者能借助蒙扎的长直道迅速提升名次，把对这位19岁车手争冠征程的损害降到最低。
在如今竞争格局变得紧凑得多的背景下，安东内利究竟能走多远很难预测，同样难以预测的还有受能源供应限制的2026年赛车能带来多少超车。据阿斯顿·马丁老将阿隆索所说，梅赛德斯显然做出了正确的选择，他预测安东内利能够登上领奖台。
"前三名。这条赛道有很多直道，所以对他很有利，"阿隆索在蒙扎比赛周开始前说道。
周五练习赛几乎没有提供任何反驳这位狡猾西班牙人的证据，梅赛德斯定下了基调，拉塞尔在第二次自由练习中领跑。不过虽然迈凯伦看起来处于被动，法拉利改进后的动力单元却似乎要来搅局，安东内利必须击败勒克莱尔和汉密尔顿中的至少一位，才能与赛前大热门拉塞尔一同登上领奖台，同时他还要克服从队尾发车带来的赛道位置劣势以及预计约20秒的比赛时间损失。
安东内利在练习中看到的景象——他在跟在法拉利赛车后面进行正赛调校时——并没有给他带来信心。
"法拉利在新引擎方面确实前进了一步，现在最高速度已经持平了,"安东内利表示。"我们知道他们的车在弯道里有多强，所以明天与拉塞尔争夺杆位肯定会是一场激烈的较量。
"这是一条可以尝试很多不同东西的赛道，今天的长距离测试很有意思，跟在其他车后面观察他们做了什么不同的调整，他们的能量部署（英文：deployment）在哪里和我们的不一样。
安东内利声称梅赛德斯和法拉利的最高速度相同，这一点在GPS数据上并不完全站得住脚，因为在排位赛模式下，拉塞尔的梅赛德斯在蒙扎四条长直道中的三条上明显高于法拉利赛车，差距平均在5公里每小时左右。
"直道速度是相当需要担心的问题,"汉密尔顿说。"光看刚才的差值，我在直道上就落后了乔治大约0.6秒。这是我们需要研究的东西。
唯一一个局面反转的直道是通往最后一弯帕拉波利卡的那条长直道，法拉利在那里快了5到6公里/小时，这表明在前面的阿斯卡里变线——那个快速的左-右-左组合弯——中，法拉利采用了不同的能量释放策略。
费尔南多·阿隆索预测基米·安东内利将登上领奖台。
当被问到阿隆索关于登台的预测时，梅赛德斯的副领队布拉德利·洛德表示，位于布拉克利的车队同样会为安东内利获得大量积分而感到满意。
洛德说："如果费尔南多的赌注兑现、他真能猜中，那我们确实会非常高兴。""我认为我们的目标是争取进入稳稳能拿积分的位置。我们看到乔治在匈牙利实际上是从队尾发车的，之后仍然能够追回到那个位置。在起步时遇到那个问题之后，他依然成功冲了上去。"
"很难对此做出太精确的预测，因为你不知道比赛会如何展开，虚拟安全车和安全车会带来什么影响。在过去几场比赛中，我们在虚拟安全车（VSC）方面有点不走运，所以也许现在是命运之轮转向的时候了，也希望有一些事情能对我们有利。"

detailEn: Why Kimi Antonelli’s Italian GP recovery may be tougher than expected
Fernando Alonso tipped Antonelli to climb from last to third at Monza, but Ferrari’s improved engine performance has made the Mercedes driver less confident

When Mercedes put sentiment to one side and made the rational decision to let Kimi Antonelli take a fifth Formula 1 power unit in his home race, landing him a back-of-the-grid start for exceeding his allowance for the year, it did so for a good reason.

With the strength of Mercedes' 2026 power unit, and a freshly built example no less, Mercedes is expecting its young challenger to quickly move up the order on Monza's long straights, limiting the damage to the 19-year-old's title campaign.

Quite how far Antonelli can go on what has become a much tighter field is tough to predict, along with how much overtaking the energy-starved 2026 cars will produce. According to Aston Martin veteran Fernando Alonso, Mercedes certainly made the right call as he predicted a podium spot for Antonelli.
"Top three. There are a lot of straights, so it is good for him," Alonso said ahead of the Monza weekend.

Friday practice offered little evidence to contradict the wily Spaniard, as Mercedes set the tone with George Russell leading FP2. But while McLaren looked like it was on the back foot, Ferrari's improved power unit appears to throw a spanner in the works, as Antonelli would have to defeat at least one of Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton to join pre-event favourite Russell on the rostrum, while also overcoming the track position and estimated 20-second race-time loss associated with starting from the back.
What Antonelli saw in practice, working on his race set-up while following the Ferraris around, didn't inspire confidence.

"Ferrari definitely took a step forward with the new engine and now the speeds are the same," Antonelli reported. "We know how good their car is in the corners, so for sure it's going to be a tight fight for pole tomorrow [with Russell].

"It's a track where you can do so many different things and it was interesting in the long run today, running behind other cars to see what they were doing differently, where they were deploying compared to us."

Antonelli's claim that the top speeds between Mercedes and Ferrari are the same doesn't quite pass the GPS test, as in qualifying trim Russell's Mercedes was noticeably up on the Ferraris across three of Monza's four long straights, the gap sitting around an average of 5km/h.

"Straight-line speed, it's considerable to worry about," Hamilton said. "Just looking at the deltas just there, I was losing something like six tenths to George, just in the straights. Which is something we need to look into."

The only straight where the tables were turned was the long run towards Parabolica, the final corner, where the Ferraris were 5-6km/h faster, a telltale sign of a different energy deployment strategy through the preceding Variante Ascari, the fast left-right-left combination.
Fernando Alonso predicted a podium finish for Kimi Antonelli
When asked about Alonso's podium prediction, Mercedes' deputy team principal Bradley Lord said the Brackley squad would also be satisfied with a strong haul of points for Antonelli.

"If Fernando's bet pays off and it pays out for him, then we'll be very happy indeed," Lord said. "I think we're aiming to get up into solid points-paying positions. We saw George able to do that in Hungary after effectively starting from the back. Following this challenge he had off the start line, he was still able to get back up there.

"It's hard to put too precise a prediction on it, just because you don't know how the race will unfold, what virtual safety cars and safety cars might do. We've seen in the last few races we've been a little unlucky with VSCs, so maybe it's time for the wheel to turn on that one and something to play into our hands as well."
